task.target: Next-month unique received vehicle complaints per known make/model

input_units.lag1: prior calendar month unique ODINO count

task.timing_contract: Only prior-month LDATE received counts predict next month. Retrospective snapshot may revise product labels and records; historical DATEA/report publication lag means calendar causality is not verified as-issued availability. No incident-date future information used.
task.calibration: Cohort selected before targetperiod using>=6receivedJan–Jun2025complaints. Development targetsJul2025–Apr2026, rolling forward blocks; May–Jul2026confirmation. No target-month counts enter predictors.
task.independent_unit: Whole target months; same known vehicle cohorts repeat, lag windows overlap. Three held months are not independent fleets or defect experiments.
task.scope_limits: Administrative complaint workload among known productVmake/model labels, not vehicle failures or safety risk. No fleet-at-risk denominator, reporting propensity or causal recall effect; dedupODINO/vehicle across components, snapshot relabeling remains.

exposure.schema: Only schema and source-publication aggregate descriptions inspected; reserved target values and scores not inspected.

task.uncertainty_policy: Whole-group errors/ranges; no row bootstrap or manufactured independent-population confidence. Confirmation becomes exposed after freeze.

selection: Minimize group-balanced primary error; prefer fewer coefficients within1percent of minimum; baseline may win.
stopping: At least5distinct scientific hypotheses, adaptive to development evidence; stop after2consecutive substantive attempts without accuracy/robustness/interpretation gain.
